Fire pit, pavilion, gas grill. Guest lounge with Wi-Fi and DISH TV. Laundry facilities, feed store and restaurants nearby. Lazy Horse Ranch is a vacation hot spot for equine campground enthusiasts pursuing Bucket List horseback riding in southeastern Arizona. We have a campground in Arizona with all the amenities you need for your stay. Location notes: Southeastern Arizona, From Willcox we are 20 miles south of I-10, also easy access from Hwy. 191 via Kansas Settlement Road.

name: Lost Cowboy Ranch, Brian and Susan Bowers
description: We can accommodate up to 3 groups at a time, making your visit more enjoyable and less crowded. We have two areas available for overnight and extended stays. The first is 2.3 acres, fenced with 4 rail pipe fencing. Very private with 2 sites approximately 130 feet apart. Each site has up to 4, 12' x 16' 4 rail stalls, 30 amp electric, septic and water. There is also a 6' x 6' dog run at one site. There is a 20' gate opening for the larger rigs and circle drive for easy parking. The second area is inside our 5 acre fully fenced property. The site is to the North, with shade trees, 2 - 12' x 16' 4 rail stalls, 30amp electric, septic and water. All sites afford beautiful mountain views and lots of privacy. The second site is for smaller rigs under 40 feet. There is a fully lighted roping arena and sorting pen with cattle available on site. Round pen and horse turn out also available. Enjoy beautiful mountain views, gorgeous sunrises and tranquil sunsets. Located 1 mile from Tonto National Forest, 3 miles from the Verde River and 2 miles from the challenging trails of the McDowell Mountain Regional Park. All provide endless horse trails for hours of riding. Hiking, mountain biking and golf are also just minutes away. And when you are not on trail, we provide high speed Wi-Fi for your use to stay in touch or stream movies for your enjoyment. There is easy access to property with less that half a mile on a dirt road. Short term or long term stays are welcome. Restaurants, feed & tack, and convenience store are located about 10 minutes away. Ranch sorting events and Roping practice are also held here, call for a schedule of events. We look forward to meeting you and your horse. Dogs are welcome. (Cats, Rabbits, Pigs, Goats, etc.). Location notes: 160th Street and Dixileta, just 1 mile north of Dynamite in the beautiful Rio Verde area of North Scottsdale. Check us out on Facebook to see more pictures. Credit Cards are accepted (3% surcharge will be added)

name: McClure Ranch, Jean McClure
description: 14 - covered 20' x 40' stalls, alfalfa and bermuda hay provided. Round pen, arena, wash rack, and pasture turn outs. $20/night. Health certificate and negative Coggins test required. Please call ahead to confirm space available. Location notes: Southwestern Arizona, just a few miles from I-8, midway between Phoenix and San Diego.

name: Mesa, Arizona, Wild West Town & Ranch
location: 1601 W Williams Field Road, Mesa , AZ 85212
address: 1601 W Williams Field Road, Mesa , AZ 85212
description: Our horse accommodations were newly built by professionals and include a 4-stall mare motel with rubber mats, individual feeders, automatic waterers, and spacious 12' x 24' runs. The shaded, open-air barn keeps horses comfortable year-round. A turnout corral with dual entrances is available, along with dedicated space to park and store your trailer away from the horses. We also offer covered RV storage with electrical hookups (additional fee per vehicle) and a brand-new RV gate along the north side of the property. Rates are $25 per horse per night and $50 per night for dry camping on our lot. A covered hay and tack room is provided in an adjacent building. The property is well-lit with both standard and solar lighting for your convenience and safety. For overnight stays, our Casita - set up like an Old Western town and complete with a Saloon, General Store playroom, pool, hot tub, and more - is available for booking on Airbnb. It sleeps 4 comfortably, with additional sleeping arrangements available upon request. Location notes: We are ideally located just minutes from Phoenix-Mesa Gateway Airport and just outside the Mesa, AZ city limits. The property is only 7 minutes from the Arizona Athletic Grounds and 20 minutes from Horseshoe Park & Equestrian Centre, making it a convenient stop for equestrian events, shows, and travelers. Contact: For questions or reservations, please contact Chris at 1-844-WWTRBNB or 1-844-998-7262

name: Montezuma Old West Ranch House, Scott Irving
location: 1512 N Montezuma Heights Road, B309, Camp Verde , AZ 86322

description: $15 per head. You provide feed for your horses. You feed, water and clean up after them. We have two covered pens plus an extra area for a 3rd horse. 1 barn stall with run is also available at $20 for the night. We have extra panels to set up to accommodate more horses if needed. Plenty of space for your rig. $25 a night extra for you to stay on site in your Living Quarters. Water is available. Electric by extension cord only. Sorry, no A/C or heater hook up yet. No dump station. We have a Cowboy Cabin that is periodically available to rent for over night stays. Call for availability. We also have an LQ horse trailer that may be available for bunking in for over nighters. It offers a comfie queen size bed. You will have hot and cold water but...the shower is a bit unpredictable in it (it can turn cold intermittently while showering!) The LQ is available for $50 per night. Hay is available at Camp Verde Feeds (928-567-3351). There are a lot of trails nearby for you to enjoy if you are not just passing through. Roping arena just up the road. We are at the end of the road, so very quiet area. Location notes: From I-17 exit Middle Verde Road, go east (towards Casino). Go through (busy) roundabout and the road becomes Montezuma Castle Hwy. Stay on Montezuma Castle Hwy 1.1 miles to Arena Del Loma Rd. Go right (west) onto Arena Del Loma. Take Arena Del Loma 0.5 miles to Montezuma Heights Road. Go left (south). This is a bumpy, gravel road that is less than a 1/4 mile long and it smooths out towards the end. It dead-ends at our Montezuma Old West Ranch House. Go past the house toward the yellow diamond shaped signs to second set of chain link double gates. You have arrived!

name: Phoenix, Arizona, Windrush Ranch, LLC
description: We are a full-service boarding and rehab facility that is completely fenced and gated. With over 50 years of working with horses, we not only understand the fantastic gift of horses but we also understand the difficulties sometimes encountered in owning them. We are here for you. We also have 7 full RV hookups for those of you who are traveling with your horses. Let us be your peaceful Safe Haven at the end of a long day on the road or if you would like to stay with us for an extended time. "SNOWBIRDS" ARE WELCOME! We have 14 bedded 16' by 18' safe and roomy, 1/2-covered pens for your horses and easy pull throughs and backups for your LQ or RV. We have plenty of room for big rigs. With a 60' round pen with 6' high fencing and 2 spacious arenas for riding, exercise or short turnouts, you are welcome to enjoy your horse however you wish. Or, you can ride right out our front gate for some quiet trail riding in our desert neighborhood. Please check out our website for more info. We look forward to meeting you. Location notes: We are located in north Phoenix, right off of Carefree Highway, 4.5 miles east of I-17.

name: Rio Rancho Verde
description: Awarded the 2020 Most Serene Desert Accommodation & Horse Boarding Facility – Southwest USA by LUX Magazine. We are located on 62 acres, our upscale, luxury Equine Eco-Ranch is perched on the edge of the Tonto National Forest, one half mile down the road from the Scottsdale Sonoran Preserve and 20 minutes from North Scottsdale (30 minutes from Westworld). Ride out our back gate into miles of spectacular Sonoran Desert, no need to trailer. We offer 3 barns, 21 large covered stalls with automatic waterers, 2 arenas, a turnout, 2 round pens, wash rack, full hook-ups (2 with decks), organic garden (seasonal, help yourself), covered dog run, wifi, laundry facilities and Party Pit. Hay available on site. We also have a contemporary Western Bunkhouse/Casita with full kitchen, separate bathroom with private courtyard, a two bedroom suite with private pool overlooking the spectacular desert scenery and a large luxury travel trailer situated on the edge of the Tonto National Forest. Million Mile Magazine recognized Rio Rancho Verde as one of the top 10 spots to celebrate the 10th anniversary of Airbnb, VRBO selected us (1 of 5 out of 3500 short term rentals in Scottsdale) to film a social media promotion on luxury properties on YouTube, Horse & Rider Magazine featured the Ranch under their Don t Miss This section for stays in Scottsdale during the Arabian Horse Show, Hulu filmed an Indigenous Cooking series here and a Western movie crew shot scenes for their film production. The ranch is remote, secluded, scenic and simply spectacular, yet close enough to Scottsdale to enjoy fine dining, shopping and nightlife, although most people choose to stay put and enjoy the quiet, peaceful and serene solitude our location provides. For more information on boarding options, the bunkhouse, etc., please click on the links below. You can also contact us through our website, which offers more information on our commitment to sustainability, and providing the best in equine hospitality. Bedroom suite with pool: Bedroom suite with pool Bunkhouse/casita: Bunkhouse/casita Travel Trailer: Travel Trailer Location notes: North Scottsdale - Just east of I-17 and north of Carefree Highway.

description: Open from October through April. Your horses can share a 24' x 24' semi-covered pen that can be closed off from the 60' round pen by a gate (or left open if they get along). There is also one stand-alone 24' x 12' uncovered pen. Horses are $15/night each with guests providing feed and mucking. There is a room for rent ( https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/49575374 ), dry camping for up to three trailers at $20/night/rig. Two feed stores and two veterinarians are within 8 miles, and "town" is less than 10 miles away. The host is a professional wrangler and can accompany riders if she's not working. A 2-horse gooseneck slant is available so guests can access other local trailheads for $20/day (please call before arrival). There are 4 nice rides right off the property. We accept cash, checks, Zelle, and Venmo once we've talked and finalized your dates. A 50% deposit and reservations are required. Link to Saguaro National Park Maps (we are located in the West, Tucson Mountains, District): https://www.nps.gov/sagu/planyourvisit/maps.htm Location notes: Directions to the China Cabinet Ranch: Use the link to Google Maps because other mapping apps will get you lost once you exit the park. The barn and surrounding property are monitored by security cameras, and the facility can be secured behind locked gates for additional peace of mind. Guests are welcome to bring their own feed and hay. For overnight accommodations, enjoy our beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 3-bath apartment located directly above the barn. Another cool place to check out is the Palomino Ranch clothing shop in town and the L& F grocery store. Our Ranch is close to State Land and is a beautiful area with scenic views. Deer and elk are often seen. An occasional rattle snake about once a year cross through so be on guard where you walk. Coyotes can sometimes be heard in the night that sometimes cross through the ranch. Children under 18 must be with a parent at all times. Pets are welcome but must stay on a leash and doggie bags are provided for you to clean up after them. We are a rustic, western horse ranch that takes pride in a clean facility and would ask that you clean up after your own horses. Thank you and God Bless. I have a 110 volt outlet for an RV hook up. Location notes: Go 5 miles south from Chadron on Hwy. 385, turn west at the King Canyon Road-Country Club Road signs, go to the stop sign, turn south for 150 feet and our driveway is on the right with RUJODEN Ranch gate sign. The horse corrals are within 300 feet south of our driveway with easy access for large trailers.

description: Over 25 indoor stalls available, with included bedding and water buckets (if you would like). $25 per night per horse. 3 electrical hook ups available at $10 per night. Large barn yard can accommodate big rigs. Geneva Inn Motel is only a mile or 2 from us. Their number is 402-759-3176. There are also a few restaurants close by. (Please note - the phone number listed here for our ranch is a land line/no text.) Our ranch is the home of Doc's Jack Sprat & the "Jae Bars"! Been raising and training cutting horses here for over 60 years. Location notes: We are on the north side of Geneva, and only a mile off of Hwy. 81. From Hwy. 81 take the R Street exit into town (west) and go about a mile. You will then come to a stop sign. Go straight through that intersection and we are the 1st place on the north (right).

name: Grand Island, Nebraska, Lazy K Arena
location: 5700 S Locust Street, Grand Island , NE 68801
address: 5700 S Locust Street, Grand Island , NE 68801

Location notes: Easy access to I-80. Just over a mile north of the interstate. Grand Island Exit 314.

Call during office hours, Monday through Friday, 8:00 to 4:00 p.m. Location notes: We are located just off I-80 at exit 237, 2 miles north, right (east) on Walnut Street, 1 block east turn south into grassy parking area. GPS Coordinates: 40.7719, -99.73681. Do not use Google Maps address of 400 E. Walnut - that is not correct.

name: Lincoln, Nebraska, K/B Stables
description: Overnight boarding, just off Interstate 80, take exit 409. We have inside or outside boarding. We have 2 RV hookups, one with 30 amp service and a hose for water. You are welcome to stay with us, with or without horses. Contact us for further information. Location notes: Northeast of Lincoln and convenient to I-80.

name: Nebraska City, Nebraska, Diesel Rodeo Productions
description: We offer long and short term boarding! We have hook-up's, stalls and some runs when available. We have a bunk house Airbnb that can sleep 5. It has a bathroom and shower on the main floor.Plenty of room for big rigs. Need a place to layover? We welcome you! Location notes: Southwest of Nebraska City.

name: Norfolk, Nebraska, Husker Horse Hotel
description: Husker Horse Hotel offers overnight stabling with turnout and feed available. The equine facilities include covered stalls, pipe runs, and a large turnout pen. Easy access for large rigs. Barn suite with full kitchen and electric hookups are available to stay on site. Negative coggins and health papers are required for each horse. Location notes: Located in northeast Nebraska just 2 miles off highway 81.

name: Ogallala, Nebraska, Jump Rope Stables, LLC
description: We are a privately owned facility located 4 miles from the I-80 exit into Ogallala (exit 126). We have 7 dedicated stalls (10' x 12') plus 7 more if needed for your traveling equines. If you would rather your horse stay outside with a bit more room to move, we have 4 paddocks. We are on paved road all the way from exit 126. We can accommodate large rigs and most of the time you can pull in the East drive and pull out another drive so no backing required. Rates are $40 per head per night. We will not accept horses in after 9 p.m. Negative Coggins (within 1 year) and current Health Certificate (within 30 days). We provide water and bedding (we use pelleted wood). Stalls are sprayed with a disinfectant prior to your arrival and again after you leave. We also have 2- 30 amp services if you would like to hook up and stay here for the night- $30. DOGS: We do allow dogs, however they must be current on all vaccinations. Please have vet documentation. We do have our own dogs and some of them are puppies, so in order to keep our own dogs/puppies safe and other traveling dogs. Please make sure your pets are UTD on shots. Location notes: 274 Road West 70, Ogallala, NE 69153

name: Sidney, Nebraska, Tumbleweed Stables
description: 50' x 50' pens, outdoor arena, 3 round pens, big rig access. Location notes: Located 6 miles from exit 59, I-80. Call for exact directions.

name: Waverly, Nebraska, I-80 Equine
description: Up to 6 stalls available, outdoor pens with automatic water. Indoor Arena 120' x 60'. Outdoor arena 200' x 100' with lights, roping sled also anvailable. Easy access for large trailers. 20/30 amp electrical hook ups. Easy water access. Sleeping arrangements can be available in the main house. Summertime access to in-ground pool and shower in pool house. Restroom is available in the indoor arena. All horses must he current on vaccines and coggins. May ask for paperwork/health papers. Location notes: Located 5 miles from exit 409 off of interstate 80. Or 15 miles from exit 420 off of interstate 80. 10 minutes to Sandhills Global (previously Lancaster event center). All pavement to our property. 1 mile east of Waverly.

name: York, Nebraska, Diamond B, Inc
description: 21 indoor bedded stalls, 6+ turnout pens, indoor and outdoor arenas, circle drive. On-site sleeping accommodations available. Please visit our website to get the entire list of what we have to offer. Location notes: York is located at the junction of US Hwy. 81 and Interstate 80 in East Central Nebraska.

name: Free Spirit Farm, Caitlin Noonan
description: My name is Caitlin Noonan, my farm is Free Spirit Farm in Nottingham NH. My property is 4 acres where my 2 horses live as well as 2 boarders. My farm is retirement board mainly as I do not have facilities for riding currently. My horses live outside 24/7 with run in sheds, free choice hay, paddocks and sheds cleaned at least 1 X Day. I have a 4-stall barn with two of the stalls having small in & outs. Sheds have fans for warmer months, and heated waterers for colder months. For overnight and short stays, if I do not have a paddock open, horses will stay in the barn with in & out. I also have 2 large grass paddocks for grazing in nicer months If your horse is acclimated to grass, they have the option of using those paddocks. All I want is for all my animals I care for to be happy and healthy, I try to keep living arraignments as close as natural/wild as possible. If you prefer to camp out on the property, that can be accommodated as well. Very laid back and willing to accommodate what I can within reason. For one horse the fee is $50/night. This includes clean water, bedding, and cleaning the stall/ paddock daily. You must provide your own grain, hay, supplements, bug spray, blankets, etc. Hay can be provided at an additional cost. Again I am laid back and open to negotiating this, depending on needs, etc. For multiple horses the fee is $40/night (clean water, bedding, and cleaning of stall/paddock daily). Any questions please reach out via email/phone. All horses must have up to date vaccine paperwork and negative coggins within 1 year. Location notes: West of Durham and minutes away from route 101, access to route 95 and 93.

name: Golden Ridge Stables, Catherine Behrens
description: 50 acres. 9 stall barn, paddock with run-ins, indoor arena, riding trails directly from property. Paddock with run-in - $35, Stalls - $40, or Both - $50. Trailer parking. Possible trailer hookup. Hotels and food within 15 minutes from the house. Location notes: Easy in/out to I-91. Close to Mass, CT, Vermont.

name: Pingree Hill Farm, Linda Saba
description: 10' x 12' matted stall, tack room, large dressage ring. Water, power, electric, turnout are available. We also give lessons, Location notes: East of Manchester.

name: Riley's Farm, Linsay Rich
description: 12' x 12' matted stalls with shavings included, flexible arrival and departure times, 70' x 144' indoor lighted arena, indoor round pen, lighted outdoor arena and round pen, x-country jump and versatility course, trailer parking, potty. Owners are welcome to stay in their trailers on the property. Location notes: Easy access off major highways, off Route 101. Exit 7 in Epping, NH. Route 125 North and the farm is on Route 87. Close to Pawtuckaway, Bear Brook state parks and Seacoast beaches for riding. Easy access from Mass and up to Maine and via highways.

name: The Spot!, Mason Craig
description: A fabulous 4 bedroom, 2 bath rental house that happens to have a 2 stall stable with running water and electricity. Location notes: Southeast of Laconia and in the heart of The Lakes area.

name: Blairwood Farms, Inc
description: When your horse boarding needs become serious, think of Blairwood Farms. We are going into our 25th year of business serving the standardbred community. Located in the heart of New Jersey s beautiful horse country, we are conveniently located within minutes of all the standardbred breeding farms and large training centers. We specialize in all areas of standardbred care; broodmares, yearlings, or your racehorse turnouts. We can also provide after surgery care and rehabilitation. Every horse we care for becomes part of our family. At Blairwood Farms every detail is important to our family owned and operated business. We are now offering services for our traveling customers by offering horse motel services. Our private farm will make you feel at home while you are traveling through our area or at a special event here in New Jersey. A current coggins and health certificate are required. Our fees are $35.00 for each horse per day. You supply your grain, we supply your hay. We have alfalfa hay and grass timothy mix. Hook up for camper is available if needed at an additional charge of $10.00 per day. Location notes: We are located 5 miles off the New Jersey Turnpike at exit 7, Bordentown. There are several motels and restaurants at exit 7 for your convenience.

name: TK Rest Stop, Tara Hynes
location: 61 Gravel Hill - Spotswood Road, Monroe, NJ 08831
address: 61 Gravel Hill - Spotswood Road, Monroe, NJ 08831

name: Bar Key Horse Motel, Dan Key

description: As of January, 2026 we offer seven open air horse stalls. Four stalls are 16' x 20' and three stalls are about 12' x 16'. There is about 2-3 feet in between each stall to minimize contact. We have full hook-up, pull-through sites next to the horse stalls. Advance reservation required. City water, muck buckets, clean-up tools and dumpsters are available. Guests must have own feed and water buckets and gate lock, if desired. Guests have full responsibility for horses. Amenities in the main building are available to all guests: 3 self-enclosed restrooms with showers, laundry room, rec room, free coffee, camp store, games on patio - including a 9-hole mini golf, dog park. Park owners do not have any contact with horses. We are an RV Park that is unique to have horse stalls available. Current health certificates and negative Coggins required at check-in. Current pricing as of 1/21/26 are $25 per horse. Site rent for full hookup, pull-thru site for LQ/RV with trailer are $45 with discount or $49.53 no discount. Subject to change. ADVANCE RESERVATION REQUIRED - NO WALK-INS. Call office - or go to our website and select link to our reservation system, Campspot. Horse drop-off is available if owner has no LQ. Again, owners are solely responsible for their horses. Location notes: Physical address is: 2500 E Route 66 Blvd, Tucumcari, NM 88401. Some gps may show 2500 E Tucumcari Blvd. Same location. Route 66 is just off of I-40 annd Highway 54. From I-40, exit 335 is easiest as it leads directly to Route 66.

address: 2913 Gun Club Road, S.W., Albuquerque , NM 87121

We have two beautiful Guest houses on the property, one allows pets, one does not. One house has 2 king size beds, two twin beds and a futon with full kitchen and separate bedroom The other house has 1 king size bed and a queen futon in the same room, and a kitchenette. Both are only rented to one party at a time. Tons of ammenties in both houses. There are tons of available food venues within a mile of us and a liquor store and yummy Mexican food truck across the street Owner lives on the property. Each stall has its own sanitized heated electric water and a tub for each pen if needed. We are easily accessible for any big rigs and have electrical and water hookups.We offer monthly/nightly rates and have hay on site if needed.We also have large outdoor pens. We live on the premises, love people and horses, and look forward to meeting you. Location notes: We are exactly 1 mile west from the only stop light in town on US 56/Springer Highway. Historical down town Clayton is easily accessible.

name: Edgewood, New Mexico, Sweet Melody Farm, LLC
description: This is a gated, safe and secure location. We offer 2 large paddocks with matted shelters and automatic waterers. Pen 1 has a 12' x 12' matted shelter within a 100' x 200' paddock with a Ritchie waterer. Pen 2 has a 30' x 12' matted loafing shed attached to the barn within a 100' x 165' paddock with a Nelson pedestal Nelson waterer (heated in winter). $25/per horse. NO STALLIONS. We have 2 RV hookup sites. Full hookup site has 30/50 amp, water and sewer and is located adjacent to Pen 2 . Second site has 110 electric/water and located adjacent to Pen 1 . Airbnb rooms are available onsite and can be reserved thru Airbnb. at 2 room option and 1 room option . No pets inside please. Location notes: 30 miles east of Albuquerque, 35 miles west of Clines Corners and 60 miles south of Santa Fe. Wide entrance and large circular driveway.

name: Edgewood, New Mexico, TCB Ranch
description: Horse boarding and overnight stabling facility available on a 40-acre property at the foot of South Mountain, conveniently located approximately 4 miles off I-40 in Edgewood, New Mexico, offering multiple boarding options and a quiet, spacious environment for horses and owners. The facility features cross-fenced pastures with loafing sheds, pipe pens and corrals, covered shelters, and a brand new 8-stall barn with indoor/outdoor access for each horse. Amenities include heated automatic waterers, a hot water wash rack, tack room space, sheltered pens, and well-maintained grounds designed for safety and ease of care. Horses have access to large riding arena, round pens, and plenty of ride-out opportunities directly from the property. We offer a private gated entrance for added security, along with ample parking and easy trailer access with plenty of room for turnaround, including larger rigs, as well as two 50-amp RV hookups. Monthly full-care boarding and overnight/short-term boarding are both available as separate programs with different service structures. Additional care services such as feeding, hay, grooming, blanketing, and medication or supplement administration are available upon request. Whether you're stopping overnight or looking for long-term boarding, we provide a quiet, comfortable, and welcoming environment for both horses and their owners. Location notes: Just 4 miles off I-40 in Edgewood, New Mexico, with direct access from Highway 344 for easy on/off travel. Located in a quiet area at the base of South Mountain, approximately 30 minutes from Albuquerque and about an hour away from Santa Fe. Easy access and turnaround for large rigs and trailers.

name: Grants, New Mexico, Slash M Slash Ranch

name: High Country Arena
description: 16 covered 12' x 12' box stalls, 4 covered 20' x 20' stalls, 31,590 sq. ft. covered riding arena, 50 ft. round pen. 16 30/50 amp. R.V sites with water and sewage. We also have a 5 stand sporting clays course. We can facilitate lodging just 2 miles from the arena at the Mayhill Cafe and Hotel also. Location notes: Two miles from Mayhill, New Mexico, in the Sacramento Mountains, surrounded by numerous trails in the Lincoln National Forest.

name: Just Keep Swimming, Inc., Krista Perry
description: 50amp, 30amp hookup - Horse trailer parking - Water hook up. Separate pens available to make different sizes. Covered pens available. Arena access with Barrels. Round pen access. Inquire for hay purchase and availability. Willing to accommodate your needs. Fully fenced with locked gates. Location notes: 5 miles, straight shot off Interstate 40.

name: Kiva RV Park and Horse Motel, Robert Cronk
description: We are a family-owned facility that offers safe, reliable horse accommodations since 1998. New owner as of 02/01/2018. We can handle up to 10 RVs. We have 6 - 30 amp and 4 - 30/50 amp electrical and water hookups, for your LQ or RV's. We also have full RV hooks with electric, water, and sewer. Free WiFi connection for the first 48 hours. Horse accommodations are choice of 5 pipe corrals 3 (50' x 90') and two large corrals (120' x 120'), all with animal shelter. We also have 4 xox stalls with runs (box is 12' x 10', run is 12' x 30' and 7 red stalls (box is 10' x 10' and run is 10' x 20'. We also have 4 xox stalls that are 12' x 10'. We can provide fresh shavings. We have a 300' x 300' area for any mobile corrals to be put up (horse wwner provided). We also have a 60' round pen. Alert us about 30 minutes before your arrival so we can have fresh water ready. We also have hot showers, laundry, and general store on site. Side notes is you wish to stay a few days. Trail rides & desert scouting. Ride directly from the horse motel into the open desert. Quiet desert paths with mesa and mountain views. Perfect for short scouting rides or longer adventures. Wildlife spotting - rabbits, doves, roadrunners & more. Local riding tips & trail pointers available at check-in. Click here to view the arrival of some of our horse motel customers. Location notes: GPS Directions: Coming from the north: Take exit 175. It will curve to the right. You will see a blue camping sign pointing to the left. Go across the cattle guard. Follow the paved road. The campground is on the left. Coming from the south: Take exit 175. Turn right. Go to the stop sign and turn left. Go under I-25. You will curve to the left. You will see a blue camping sign pointing to the right. Go across the cattle guard. Follow the paved road. The campground is on the left. Coming from Highway 60: Go straight under I-25. You will see a blue camping sign pointing to the right. Go across the cattle guard. Follow the paved road. The campground is on the left.

name: LAZY SUE RANCH
description: The one and only place for you and your horses to rest. Very quiet location off the beaten path. Large 20' x 20' barn and covered stalls with 20' x 40' paddocks. $30 per horse per night. Large turnouts and 8 acre pastures. Equipped with 2 round pens and a roping arena. $25 per horse per night. RV hook ups close to the barn allow you to be close to your horse. We also have a really nice cabin set up on site. We are offering overnight lodging for $75/night. That includes hot water, shower, electric, heating/cooling, kitchenette with coffee and tea available. Available for short or long term stay. Owners live on property and have 24 hour surveillance for top security. Open 24 hours and also have feed available. Reservations not required but are very much welcomed. All major credit cards accepted. Location notes: 10 miles east of Hwy. 549 on Josefita Road SE. 1 mile down, first barn on the left.

name: Lazy KO Ranch, Martin Ridgway
description: We offer several large multi-horse paddocks and several single or double horse paddocks that are cleaned daily and have shelter. Pull through RV spots with 50, 30, 20 & 15 amp service available as are water hookups. Fresh water daily for horses and the water is heated to 55 degrees in cold weather. We have 2 guest cabins available for our guests' comfort. Lots of great horse or off-road vehicle riding on and near the ranch, including sand dunes. We also offer local tours of mines, petroglyphs, canyons, ghost towns, etc. We offer circular drives and multiple gates, so no backing. We can accommodate just about any rig size from single trailer to big rig. Location notes: 15205 Highway 549 SE, Deming, NM 88030.

name: Open Heart G Farms, Maggie
description: Overnight Stalls available in a beautiful 25 acre Pecan Orchard. Indoor stalls OR very large, approximately 1/4 acre. Safe, cleaned daily, outdoor turnouts with access to covered stall. We can accommodate up to 15 horses. Studs welcome! We have 7 bedded 14' x 14 box' stalls are very clean and deeply bedded with shavings in an enclosed barn, 1 20' x 20' covered, bedded box stall, 1 15' x 10' covered box stall with a run, and 6 very large 1/4 acre safe turnouts with covers. Automatic waterers and buckets with fresh water are hung for horses not familiar with auto waterers. Large hay/grain feeder in each stall or turnout. Large round pen or arena is available if excersize is needed. Plenty of room for BIG RIGS. We have a very cozy Bunkhouse just a few steps from the stalls that has a queen bed and 2 twin beds, T.V with satellite, refrigerated air (summer) and heated (winter), bathroomm with shower. Coffee, tea, condiments and snacks provided. Kitchenette with dishes, microwave, etc.. We have lots of room for self contained rigs and RV Hookups (30 amp) with water available. We are just over a mile 4 minutes from the interstate. Easy off and easy on. 2 miles from upscale Western Steakhouse, Denny's or fast f ood. i.e. Mc Donald's, Wendy's, Subway, KFC, Taco bell or Mexican food. 3 Full service, 24 hour truck stops are 2 miles from us as well as a Best western or America's value Inn. Location notes: Great location Avoid the hectic El Paso traffic; we are just on the outskirts. 5 miles from El Paso City limits. 1 mile from New Mexico/Texas state line. Our stables are located 1.5 miles west from I-10, exit 162. Turn right on 404, easy off and easy on. 2 miles to 3 different truck stops with 24 hour fuel, restaurants or lodging.

name: Raton, New Mexico, Wellspring Ranch & Stables

Horse owners are responsible for their own feed. Must show Health Certificate and Negative Coggins. Please visit us on Facebook for additional information and photos. Location notes: Northeastern New Mexico, 20 miles south of Colorado state line. Exit 452 east off I-25. Go 1/4 mile east and right onto Jackson Lane, continue straight onto property.

description: Three large corrals . . . 3700sf, 4700sf, 5700sf. All are stallionworthy and have covered shelters, rubber matting, no-climb horse fencing, grain & hay feeders, heated water bins. Cozy feed room with refrigerator and table/chairs. Practice arena. Entire property is cross-fenced. Owner on-site. Trailer hookups available. Accessibility for all rig sizes. Location notes: Nestled in the Rio Grande valley between Albuquerque and Santa Fe on historic Route 66 with easy access from I-25 and I-40.

Go north (left after the exit) on Highway 41. Travel 4.5 miles to Western Road and turn right. We are the first driveway on your right.

name: Roswell, New Mexico, J BAR C HORSE MOTEL

Nine 12' x 30' semi-covered pens alongside an exercising arena and also a turnout pen for your use. Fresh water available. Pens are cleaned and looked after daily. Horse owner is responsible for their own horse's feed. Two LQ Hookups with electricity and water. Plenty of space to move your rig around. Owners reside on premises with security gate access to the property. Call to make reservations. One week notice or prior arrangements for cancellations much appreciated. Please, visit our website for rates, photos and contact information. Location notes: 4 miles south of Roswell on US 285, turn west on Hobson Road, go approximately 1 mile and we are the first right turn right off the railroad crossing. For map check our website.

name: Section Eight Stables, Phyllis Gonzales

address: 100 South Polo Drive, Santa Fe , NM 87507

We offer a choice of enclosed stalls, 16' x 12', with attached pens, 16' x 18', as well as covered pipe stalls, 14' x 14'. All horse stalls have sand and wood pellet bedding (no shavings required). We are located adjacent to the RV Park at HIPICO Santa Fe, offering full hook-ups as well as restrooms and showers, and can assist with booking both equine layovers and RV sites. In approximately 2 miles, turn right onto the HIPICO Santa Fe driveway (you will see 2 flags flying at the head of the driveway). Follow signs as if you are going to the RV Park. Section Eight Stables are located just past the RV Park, across the driveway.

name: Adair, Oklahoma, I-44 Horse Hotel, LLC

The longest rigs can easily pull in/out. Our two RV pads have water and both 30 and 50 amp electric service. We offer 5 inside stalls with rubber mats and 5 covered outdoor stalls. A large turnout pen is also available. Come stay with us; we are confident you'll be glad you did! Give Travis a call at 918-323-1555 and schedule your stay! RV pad = $30; inside stall = $30, one bag of shavings included; outside stall = $15; bunkroom = $85. Extra shavings are $10 per bag, 1 bag minimum per stall required. name: Cross Creek Horse Training, LLC, Christa Smith
location: 5302 E US Hwy. 66, El Reno , OK 73036
address: 5302 E US Hwy. 66, El Reno , OK 73036
description: We are a long term and short term-training and boarding facility. Overnight boarding is located in our 22 stall insulated barn. The stalls are 12' x 12', solid, and safe. Bedding and water are provided. We ask that you use the feeder provided: buckets, feeders, and walls are sanitized between horses. They are $30 per horse per night. We accommodate all kinds of clients whether you are on a show circuit, headed to the racetrack, traveling the country for trail riding, or moving. We can even accommodate unhandled horses with pens to back the trailer up to for loading and unloading. We have an indoor arena for riding that is 80' x 80' and an outdoor arena that's approximately 100' x 200'. Trailer hookups are also available; 110v 30 amp or 240v 50 amp that are all easy to get into. Electric hookup is $15 per night and electric hookup with water is $20. If you do not have a hookup, no worries, there are several hotel options just a few miles away and the owner of the facility lives on site and check on your horses often. Current negative coggins and health certificate required upon arrival. Please show this paperwork upon check-in before unloading your horses. We are a 24 hour, 365 day facility. No specific check in time required, just be sure to call ahead to make reservations and call the day of to give an ETA. All payments are due upon arrival. Cash is preferred but we also accept Cash App, Venmo, Paypal, and checks as long as Drivers License info is provided. Location notes: We are conveniently located less than half a mile off of I-40, just 25 minutes west of OKC Fairgrounds. Our location on the google maps link above HAS been confirmed. You can also type in "Cross Creek Horse Training" on google maps and it will bring you straight to us. Here are the written directions just in case: Take I-40 to exit 127/Radio Road. Go north to the stop sign which is Route 66. Go east .2 miles, our driveway is on the south side of the road. You will see a blue and white sign that says "Cross Creek Horse Training", a red pipe fence, and a brick house. Turn in and drive all the way down and around to the barns to the left.

Blackwell has many essential services for basic shopping, fuel and food.

name: Crossroads Ranch, Dove Schmidt
description: Crossroads Ranch has been hosting kids cowboy camps for 17 years, so we have a rustic, old West setting right in-between Tulsa and Oklahoma City, about 15 minutes off I-44, and 3 miles off old Route 66. We offer two covered 10' x 12' stalls that have 20' outdoor runs included. A 32' outdoor round pen near them, and access to a 110' x 200' outdoor exercise arena. We also offer several different sized cabins, laundry area, showers, and a large bunkhouse with full kitchen. The cabins all have coffee makers, microwave, and little refrigerators in them. Coggins required, cash only. $15 per horse, cabins from $25 - $50 per night. Large bunkhouse is $15 per bunk/person. 30 Amp and 50 Amp hookup available. Our gate entry is 14' 6" tall. We are a Christian facility, and we are here to help you enjoy your trip. We hope you enjoy your stay with us! We have a good veterinarian in Bristow, Dr. Bill Mitchell, if you have any needs. Crossroads Ranch Ministries is a 501-C3 organization and donations are always appreciated and tax receipts are given. Location notes: We are located right in-between Tulsa and Oklahoma City. We are 15 minutes from the Stroud exit, just off I-44. Coming in from Bristow exit, we are 15 minutes from I-44 from the Tulsa side. We are 3.2 miles off old Route 66, just north of Depew, OK.

name: Diamond D Ranch, Donnajayne Noble, 10475 S. Pine
description: Family Friendly, Clean & professional overnight or vacation boarding facility. Offering discounts for ALL Lazy E Contestants!! New barn (2024) with private stalls, 2 NEW private 100' x 60' pipe paddocks, 3 50' x 60' paddocks all piped. 4 30/50amp electrical hook ups & 4 additional 30amp hook ups, dog kennel, picnic area & pool. Lazy E Arena is 6 miles away, RV park 1.8 miles away. OKC Fairgrounds is 30 minutes away & Oakridge Equine Hospital is 4 miles away. Easy in/out with 2 wide gates, no need to turn your rig around. Reservations required for ALL Lazy E events; spots fill up quickly. (NLBRA, JRH Finals, Red Dirt Roping Series, Barrel Bash & more). Thank you for looking and have a safe & blessed trip! Donnajayne Noble & Family. Location notes: Easy access to and from I-35, exit #146 or #151. Black top roads all the way. Easy access to the Lazy E Arena and Oklahoma City.

We are big rig friendly and will help with any accommodations. We are located 15 minutes from Ada and Sulphur, OK. Ada offers amazing hotels, restaurants and feed stores. We have a list of local vets we are happy to share as well. We also offer short term boarding for events that are held in the Ada area. Location notes: We are 4 miles north of Roff, OK to County Road 1610, then turn west and go 1/2 mile. We have a large cattle guard and we have a large gate to be big rig accessible.

After 0.7 miles, turn left on Siskiyou Blvd. Follow Siskiyou Blvd. 0.7 miles to the ranch. GPS Coordinates: N42° 169975' x W122° 661106'

name: Broken Arrow Ranch
description: Nestled in the mountains between Roseburg and the coast, Broken Arrow Ranch is a sprawling expanse of verdant green hills tucked between vineyards conveniently located adjacent to Highway 42, just minutes (about 7) from I-5 with ample space for trailer turnaround. Sporting a competition-size covered and lighted arena, an outdoor roundpen, and on-site trail riding upon request, this layover showcases the beauty of the stunning Umpqua Valley. (10) 12' x 12' tongue and groove stalls with automatic waterers are available for the horses; double stalls can be available to accommodate pairs upon request. People accommodations include four motel-style bunkhouses each with a queen size bed overlooking the barn, complete with full bath and on-site gym. Additionally, there is a 2+ bedroom homesite with a covered hot tub available for overnight accommodations. Well-behaved canine companions are welcome in either, so long as they remain leashed outdoors and are picked up after. The owner of Broken Arrow is a former equine transport professional, who looks forward to meeting and accommodating horse travelers. Please don't hesitate to call with any questions. Location notes: Located on Highway 42 heading for the coast, just outside of the Winston area.

Hay is available upon request at no additional cost. Larger (100' x 100') turnout (surrounded by electric fencing) area next to the barn available if requested at no additional cost. Wi-Fi is available to guest for free with option to stay in their own camper/trailer (under separate booking). We can offer water and electrical hookups for trailer/campers (no dump station) as well. Headed either north or south, take this Exit #33 and head (west) into the town of Central Point on East Pine Street. Go all the way through town and after crossing Highway 99, cross the railroad tracks and take the next right at the light (N. Haskell Street). Take the next left (Taylor) until it ends at Old Stage Road and go right. We are less than .5 mile on the right. Entrance with green gate is 150' past the house driveway. Whether you're headed to a show, on a cross-country trek, or just passing through, we offer a safe and relaxing overnight stay. Accommodations Include: 4 spacious 10' x 10' stalls with fresh bedding, water, and housekeeping upon checkout * Run-In Shed * An outdoor dog kennel for your four-legged travel buddy * A covered RV site with water and electric hookups (no sewer) and ample turnaround space * Tent camping spots tucked into private corners of the property. Nearby Attractions: Surrounded by nature, but close to hotels, restaurants, and stores - only 10 minutes away! * Just minutes from Percy Priest Lake and Seven Points Campground. Rates: $50/night per horse, $35/night for RV site with hookups, $25/night for tent camping. Dogs stay free with on-site guest. Hay and treats available for purchase. Short-term partial boarding may be available for extended stays - ask for details. A Few Things to Know: Full payment is required when booking within 3 days of your stay. * After-hours arrivals are welcome - just give us a heads-up in advance. * A negative Coggins test and a signed liability waiver are required before arrival. * We have three friendly miniature goats who live on-site in separate quarters within the barn. * Some of the back pasture fencing includes barbed wire, so if that is a concern we recommend staying in designated areas. So if you're looking for a quiet, horse-friendly stop near Nashville, give us a call and hang your bridle with us! Location notes: We are just 20 miles from downtown Nashville, right off the I-40 East Old Hickory Blvd. exit.

Payment required at the time of check-in. When you arrive at the farm, you will see the sign for Quail Run Farm. Come through the gate. At the fork in the road, stay to the right (lower road) that will lead you back to the barn areas. You will see tiny homes on the right and a metal "shop" barn. Behind the metal barn is a wooden gabled barn. The horse stables are on the ground floor of the gabled barn. Location notes: We are just two minutes off I-24 and only ten minutes from the I-24 / I-75 split and downtown Chattanooga.

name: Pegasus Andalusians, Cari Stewart
description: 5 - 12' x 12' stalls. 1 in/out stall available, 1 mare/foal double stall available. 4 separate pastures with 4 rail vinyl fence. Big rig pull-through. 2 - 50amp hookups, full 50amp/water & sewer hookup. Spacious private, lofted apartment. 2 arenas, trails, & hot water wash rack available. Location notes: Memphis area, off I-40 & 1-269 near Oakland, TN.

name: Phoenix Farm
description: Pasture board $25 per horse. Large run-in shelters in pastures. 3 large 12' x 14' stalls, and 2 extra large 14' x 24' stalls WITH attached paddocks. Stall board is $40 per stall (smaller stalls) and $50 per stall for extra large with attached paddocks. 8.3 miles north from exit 143 (I-40) Look for lights on fence, if arriving after dark. 24 hrs notice required. Location notes: 60 miles west of Nashville, Tennessee. Caution, there is another farm with the same name as us in Jackson, TN. Easy to find, easy access. If you are arriving after dark, look for the lights on the fence!

name: Rising Glory Farm, Chris Carlough
description: 32 stall barn with a 60' x 230' indoor arena and a 150' x 250' outdoor arena. Stalls are 10' x 12' and turnouts are available. Out of state horses require health certificate. Location notes: Located 10 minutes from Interstate 65 on Highway 431 (Franklin Pike). From the south take exit 37 Highway 50 East to Highway 431 North. We are approximately 7 miles north on the left. From the north take exit 46 Highway 99 East to Highway 431 South. We are approximately 8 miles on the right.

name: River Runs Thru It, Valerie Reid
description: Water & 30 amp, overnight boarding, $35/night with provided round pen, corral, 5 - 12' x 12' stalls with turn out available for use for additional $15/ea/night. Harpeth River runs through the middle & there are ponds for fishing. Historic Liepers Fork is a scenic 8 mile ride to famous Pucketts for lunch or dinner. Proof of negative coggins required. Location notes: Situated 7 miles south of downtown Franklin and 3 miles North off 840 (Carters Creek exit). Our official address is 3550 Gray Lane, Thompson's Station, TN 37179. From I-65, travel west toward Memphis, exit Carters Creek Pike, go approximately 3 miles north and turn left on Perkins road, make the 1st right onto Gray Lane, property is the 2nd farm on right. It has split rail fencing.br>

name: Southern Star Farm, Bud & Lelia Sikes
description: 1 barn with six 12' x 12' box stalls, 1 covered round-pen and three additional 12' x 12' stallion stalls, shavings included, outdoor grassy paddocks, well water, grain and hay available, electrical hook-up available to park trailer and stay at barn area. Location notes: One mile north of I-40 off exit 93 with easy access and turnaround for all size trailers. Completely secure with owners on site and the option to check-in any time day or night. Abundance of motels and restaurants on I-40 from exits 80 thru 85.

name: THE RED BARN INN, JENNIFER CRABTREE
description: We offer overnight and short-term boarding (2 weeks or less) here at The Red Barn Inn. We have eight stalls and paddocks available if you prefer. The stalls are oversized at 11' x 15', perfect for your larger breed horse. I also have 2 mini horse stalls as well and all stalls have mats and fans. Stalls will be ready upon arrival with bedding, and I clean up after your departure. We offer 5 RV hook-ups, electric only, with 2 50-amp plugs & 3 30-amp plugs. We are about 2 miles off the interstate exit. We have a large entrance and parking area for easy parking of large rigs. Late-night arrivals are ok because traveling does not always go as planned. I request payment with cash or Venmo. Location notes: Located right off of I-75, Exit 52. Traveling South I-75, you will take EXIT 52. Then turn LEFT off the ramp and go back over the interstate. There is a Valero on the right, turn RIGHT immediately after the Valero onto Co Rd 249 (Mt.Verd Road). Drive about 1 and a half miles, and The Red Barn Inn will be on your RIGHT.

name: Ted Barnes Cutting Horses, Ted Barnes
description: 12' x 12' box stalls, turn outs also. One all concrete barn with aluminum grills on front grate for stallions. I now have RV hook ups. Location notes: Lebanon, TN, Interstate 40 exit # 245, Linwood Road.

name: Thompson Training Center, Susan & John Thompson
description: 12' x 12' matted stalls, 2 round pens, 60' x 132' indoor riding arena, 4 horse walker, water and 30 amp electric hook ups, shavings, hay available. Stall is $30, shavings and stall cleaning included. Turn out pasture is also available and is perfect for polo teams. Reservation preferred but walk-ins are welcome. Access to State and National Park horse trails are only an hour away. Very easy access for big rigs. Circle drive parking lot..no backing ...paved road entrance with wide turns ...entire barn/parking area well lighted for late arrivals. Coggins and health papers are required. Location notes: Take I75 South to Exit 60 (from Knoxville exit left) (from Chattanooga exit right). Drive 4 miles - there will be a left turn lane... (turn left onto Frontier Road - you can't see sign until you turn ). Drive 1 mile on Frontier Road turn Left onto Guffey Road (3rd road on left - you are there). We are an easy hour drive from Knoxville or Chattanooga.

name: True West Campground And Stables, Dionja Scott
description: 34 RV sites, cabin, suite, covered wagons, bathhouses with showers, 67 stalls, pasture. We are the Gateway to the Big South Fork National Park with over 200 miles of trails

name: Twisted South Stables
description: Experience southern hospitality at our 54 stall stables. Let your horses enjoy sanitized 12' x 12' cinder block stalls (no nails) with fresh shavings. Sanitized water buckets provided. Six paddocks available upon request and also a 100' x 200' riding arena with sand. We offer (2) 30 amp and (1) 50 amp RV hookups. Generators, if needed, are provided. $35 per horse/RV nightly. Contact us for more information. Location notes: Conveniently located halfway between Nashville and Chattanooga on I-24. Take exit 105 to Hwy. 41 South. If arriving after dark, we can meet you for the short 3 mile drive to the stables. In case of emergencies, assistance is available within a 2 hour radius.

name: 13 Points Farm - Horse Motel
description: 13 Points Farm is your premier horse motel and horse boarding destination in Southeast Texas, now offering two convenient locations to serve riders and their equine companions. Our primary barn in Winnie, TX provides a welcoming, well-equipped environment for overnight travelers and long-term boarders. For guests staying in Winnie, the nearest beach access is approximately 30 minutes away. A $10 beach parking sticker is required for the peninsula and can be purchased at most local convenience stores. Both locations offer 30-amp hook-ups for your living-quarters trailer, making your stay comfortable and convenient.
